notes: Phones and the privacy notice: each app sign-in names its phone, which can be signed out alone or reported lost so the app wipes itself at its next connection; the app keeps nothing offline on an iPhone without a passcode; the privacy notice is in English and Spanish. Includes 3.0.38 (a privacy incident log with risk assessment, affected people, notices and the 60-day deadline; portal requests for a copy of records or a correction, due in 30 days, with a copy published to the client's portal), 3.0.37 (who opened a client's file and every bulk export are in the audit log; record holds stop archiving, purging and trash emptying, and key documents are deleted only by an administrator; guardian details are editable on the web and in the app; Compliance lists minors without guardian consent and clients without a privacy notice), 3.0.36 (case notes lock 30 days after they are written (an addendum corrects them) and every earlier version of an edited note is kept; adult clients sign their own release of information (by email or recorded from paper), valid for one year, with warnings before a report goes to a recipient no release covers; email subjects no longer carry client names; a Vendor agreements page records business associate agreements), 3.0.35 (referral outcomes and case closure) and 3.0.34 (getting paid). Apply dist/migrations/mig_3.0.34.sql, mig_3.0.35.sql, mig_3.0.36.sql, mig_3.0.37.sql, mig_3.0.38.sql and then mig_3.0.39.sql before updating files (safe to re-run). Sites below 3.0.31 also apply mig_3.0.31.sql; Apply dist/migrations/mig_3.0.31.sql (confirms client emails waiting for confirmation). Sites below 3.0.28 apply mig_3.0.28.sql (adds scheduled_sessions.checked_in_at) before updating files; sites below 3.0.27 apply mig_3.0.27.sql first. Sites on 3.0.16 to 3.0.20 apply mig_3.0.21.sql first. Older sites apply mig_3.0.8, 3.0.9, 3.0.10, 3.0.12, 3.0.16, 3.0.21, 3.0.27, 3.0.28, 3.0.31, 3.0.34, 3.0.35, 3.0.36, 3.0.37, 3.0.38 and 3.0.39 in order; all are safe to re-run.
